card.name: Digit 1 inside Bible verse numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 in the middle of a verse number after a colon or dash in scripture citations, where another digit follows. It also appears in some other reference numbers.

modes.description: The digit 1 as the tens digit of a verse or verse range in a scripture citation.
